text:
Casey Morgan: Quick flag 1: we've had several tickets asking why leads briefly show as unassigned before RR takes them. Can we instrument end-to-end handoff latency so sales gets a single source of truth?
Ivy Park: Absolutely. Minimal probe: recv_ts -> enrich_done_ts -> assign_ts -> first_touch_ts. Keep payload hashed, no PII.
Rafael Ortiz: +1. Add connector (hubspot|salesforce), tenant_region, owner_type (rr|default|manual) and fallback_reason. Sampling 5% initially.
June Li: Add `slo_target_ms` and `slo_breach` boolean so alerts are simple. Also include `weekday_or_weekend` tag since routing differs.
Casey Morgan: Good call. Proposal: emit one-line JSON event to topic inbound.handoff.probes, processor computes prometheus metrics and Console card. No raw emails/phones.
Ivy Park: Compliance OK as long as lead id is salted+hashed and consent flag included if available. Add opt-out: metadata.probe=false.
Rafael Ortiz: Can we also surface RR fairness metric? If some owners get >2x expected share over a window, trigger a replay and notify ops.
June Li: Yep. Add `rr_skew` sample and `fallback_rate` per-minute. Dashboard: heatmap hubspot vs salesforce + enrich latency histogram.
HSWebhookBot: webhook received portal=334 at 1755550020 (id hb_334xx)
Casey Morgan: Rollout plan: 1) internal tenant full sample 24h, 2) 5% prod 72h, 3) 25% 7d, then aggregated-only. Canary rule: if canary p95 assign latency > 3m disable sampling and page oncall.
Ivy Park: Alerts: inbound.assign.latency.p95 > 180s -> page, fallback_rate > 1.5% sustained 10m -> page.
Rafael Ortiz: Dev tasks: consumer + hashing unit tests + kafka topic. I'll own the PR. June: can you create the dashboard ticket?
June Li: Creating MKT-5001 "Handoff latency probes + RR fairness telemetry" assigned to @Rafael and @Ivy. I'll draft a short customer note for Sales/CS.
Casey Morgan: Timeline? Rafael: PR by Wed EOD, staging run Thu, prod canary next Mon.
Rafael Ortiz: Will include salted hashing per-tenant and retention policy (raw probes 7d, aggregated 90d).
Ivy Park: Also ensure sampling respects paid vs trial tenants; opt-in only for trials.
June Li: Agree. We'll route sales questions to the customer-facing blurb after the staging run.
Casey Morgan: Thanks all. If the telemetry shows unusual RR drift we can test the jitter reduction fix and replay. Revisit after staging. :rocket:
